vb_textbox.text: I found that, given a choice between a pointy hat and a round hat, the pointy hat seemed to lead to more mushrooms. I also tended to go for more purple type colours which also seemed to do well. When there was a choice between yellow round hats and red round hats, the yellow one seemed to do better. However, it seemed to change now and again so occasionally going against these rules now and again also seemed to pay off. If favouring a particular style and colour of hat, when you notice the number of mushrooms dropping for that one it's a good idea to move on to the other choice for a few goes.
